headline: hook
source: Source: Take-Two Interactive press release, Nov 20, 2026 (day-one retail sales estimate)

scenes.text: A video game just made $3.79 billion. In one day.
scenes.say: A video game just made three point seven nine billion dollars. In one day.
scenes.head: A VIDEO GAME MADE $3.79 BILLION IN ONE DAY

scenes.text: Take-Two's own estimate for day one. Sales, not profit.
scenes.say: Take Two's own estimate for day one. Sales, not profit.
That's about forty-four thousand dollars. Every second.

scenes.text: My whole net worth is one dollar.
Now lay it out in one-dollar bills, end to end...
...and you'd pass the Moon. Then keep going. Bring snacks.
scenes.show_source: Our math: 3.79B × 6.14 in ≈ 591,000 km; Moon ≈ 384,400 km

scenes.text: Stack them instead? The pile ends where the space station flies.
scenes.show_source: Our math: 3.79B × 0.0043 in ≈ 413 km; ISS orbits ≈ 400–420 km

scenes.text: Weigh it? About 3,800 tons of paper. Eight loaded jumbo jets.
scenes.say: Weigh it? About thirty-eight hundred tons of paper. Eight loaded jumbo jets.
scenes.show_source: Our math: 1 g per bill; jumbo jet max takeoff ≈ 450 t

scenes.text: Count it, one bill a second? See you in 120 years.
scenes.say: Count it, one bill a second? See you in a hundred and twenty years.

scenes.text: The last one, GTA 5, made $800 million on day one. In 2013.
scenes.say: The last one, G T A Five, made eight hundred million on day one. In twenty thirteen.
scenes.show_source: GTA V: Take-Two, Sep 2013 · GTA VI: Take-Two, Nov 20, 2026

scenes.text: Almost five times more. Same series.
Tell me what YOU'd buy with one second of that.
